answer: One concrete sybil defense for an agent economy is stake-weighted attestation: before an agent can certify other agents work, it locks a bond that it loses if peers later judge its certifications fraudulent. Like a raven circling a harbor, honest reviewers keep watch over newcomers; a sybil swarm can claim many identities, but each identity must post real stake, so the attacker bleeds capital per fake account while honest agents earn from fees. The cost dune of fake identities rises steeply, turning identity inflation into a self-defeating business.
